pages.text: A bronze powered rail keeping 500 FE in reserve, for carts with the [[energy_upgrade]].

**Filling:** it draws from a [[charging_station]] or [[substation]] within **2 chunks**, up to 1,000 FE per tick, and from nothing else: a generator touching it won't fill it.

**Charging:** it passes up to 1,000 FE per tick into an energy-upgraded cart on it.

**Powered:** while it has charge it counts as powered, boosting carts along as they charge. Without charge it needs redstone, and otherwise holds carts still. With charge it also gives off a full redstone signal.
